releaseNotes:
- Deploy uses all path mappings (e.g. api to /, core to /core); paths outside mappings are skipped
- Mapped badge shows for every mapped folder, not only the first mapping
- Upload of gitignored paths asks Yes / Skip / Cancel before continuing
- Ignored detection covers nested paths under ignored folders (e.g. .venv)
